summary.en: Youth-led Cockroach Janta protests continue across India with the party leader arrested as security forces intensify the crackdown. In Manipur Kuki-Zo groups and a women’s forum have demanded President's Rule while Congress blames the BJP for governance failure and houses were torched in an abandoned village amid ethnic tensions. The Ekta Diwas parade will feature 2,000 artists from 126 Naxal-hit districts with Prime Minister Modi attending. A bus plunged into a deep gorge in Udhampur, killing two and injuring fifteen. 437 battle-related deaths were recorded in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Ungdomsledede Cockroach Janta-protester fortsetter over hele India med partilederen arrestert mens sikkerhetsstyrkene intensiverer nedslaget. I Manipur har Kuki-Zo-grupper og et kvinneforum krevd presidentstyre mens Kongressen skylder på BJP for styringssvikt og hus ble brent i en forlatt landsby midt i etniske spenninger. Ekta Diwas-paraden vil ha 2 000 kunstnere fra 126 Naxal-rammede distrikter med statsminister Modi til stede. En buss styrtet ned i en dyp gorge i Udhampur, og to ble drept og femten såret. 437 dødsfall i kamp ble registrert i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Kashmir conflict
background.extract: The Kashmir conflict is a territorial conflict over the Kashmir region, primarily between India and Pakistan, and also between China and India in the northeastern portion of the region. The conflict started after the partition of India in 1947 as both India and Pakistan claimed the entirety of the former princely state of Jammu and Kashmir. It is a dispute over the region that escalated into three wars between India and Pakistan and several other armed skirmishes. India controls approximately 55% of the land area of the region that includes Jammu, the Kashmir Valley, most of Ladakh, the Siachen Glacier, and 70% of its population; Pakistan controls approximately 30% of the land area that includes Azad Kashmir and Gilgit-Baltistan; and China controls the remaining 15% of the land area that includes the Aksai Chin region, the mostly uninhabited Trans-Karakoram Tract, and part of the Demchok sector.
